difficulty_descriptions.easy: A small, low-pressure action you can do with little preparation.
difficulty_descriptions.medium: Takes a little thought, planning, or follow-through.
difficulty_descriptions.hard: May feel more personal or require intentional preparation.

activities.title: Send a note of appreciation
activities.description: Message someone a specific thing you appreciate about them. Keep it genuine and make no request in return.

activities.title: Check in with someone
activities.description: Ask someone how they are doing, then give them room to answer without trying to fix everything.

activities.title: Offer one practical help
activities.description: Think of someone who might appreciate help with an ordinary task and offer a specific, manageable option.

activities.title: Make time to listen
activities.description: Reach out to someone and ask if they would like to talk. Focus on understanding rather than steering the conversation.

activities.title: Follow through on an offer
activities.description: If you have offered support recently, check back and do the specific thing you said you would do.

activities.title: Reconnect thoughtfully
activities.description: Contact someone you have not spoken with in a while. Acknowledge the time apart and let them choose whether to continue the conversation.

activities.title: Share a personal thought
activities.description: Tell someone one brief thing that has encouraged you lately, and ask if they would be open to hearing it.

activities.title: Share a short experience
activities.description: Share a personal experience that you are comfortable discussing. Keep it about your own perspective and invite their thoughts.

activities.title: Pass along a helpful resource
activities.description: Send a resource you genuinely found useful, with a sentence about why you thought of them. Ask first if you are unsure they would welcome it.

activities.title: Talk about what matters to you
activities.description: If it comes up naturally, explain one way faith is meaningful in your life. Listen with the same care you hope to receive.

activities.title: Continue a conversation
activities.description: Follow up on a question someone has raised. Share what you know, be honest about what you do not, and offer to look into it together.

activities.title: Start a meaningful conversation
activities.description: Ask someone if they would be comfortable talking about faith or spiritual questions. Let their answer set the direction and pace.

activities.title: Invite someone to something casual
activities.description: Invite someone to join you for a walk, meal, or another ordinary activity. Make it easy for them to say no.

activities.title: Invite someone to a community activity
activities.description: Mention an upcoming social or service activity and share the practical details so they can decide if it sounds enjoyable.

activities.title: Invite someone to serve with you
activities.description: Offer to do a service project together. Explain what to expect and check that the activity works for them.

activities.title: Invite someone to worship with you
activities.description: Invite someone to attend a worship service or faith-centered gathering. Offer to sit with them and answer practical questions.

activities.title: Follow up on an earlier invitation
activities.description: Check whether someone has questions about an invitation you already extended. Be warm, avoid repeated pressure, and respect their decision.

activities.title: Invite someone to meet with missionaries
activities.description: Ask whether someone would like to meet with missionaries to discuss their questions. Explain what the meeting involves and leave the choice with them.

activities.title: Pray for opportunities to share the Gospel
activities.description: Pray for opportunities to share the Gospel and for help recognizing them when they come.

activities.title: Offer to pray for someone
activities.description: If someone shares a concern, ask whether they would appreciate you praying for them.

activities.title: Offer to pray with someone
activities.description: Ask if the person would be comfortable praying together. Respect their preference if they decline.

activities.title: Pray for the missionary work
activities.description: Include local missionaries, people they are teaching, and members sharing the Gospel in your prayers.

activities.title: Give someone a pass-along card
activities.description: Offer a pass-along card when it feels relevant, briefly explaining why you thought they might find it useful.

activities.title: Text a scripture or hymn to a friend
activities.description: Share a scripture or hymn that has meant something to you, with a short note about why it came to mind.

activities.title: Tell someone about your weekend
activities.description: Mention a meaningful part of your weekend, such as attending sacrament meeting, teaching Sunday School, or a Young Men campout.

activities.title: Share your testimony of missionary work
activities.description: On Fast Sunday, consider sharing a sincere testimony about missionary work, if you feel comfortable doing so.

activities.title: Sit with someone new at church
activities.description: At church, look for someone you do not know well, including a friend of the missionaries, and ask if you may sit nearby.

activities.title: Practice inviting with your kids
activities.description: Show your children how to warmly invite a friend to church, seminary, or an activity, and how to respond graciously either way.

activities.title: Write your testimony in a Book of Mormon
activities.description: Write a brief personal testimony in a copy of the Book of Mormon for missionaries to offer to someone.

activities.title: Visit a part-member family with missionaries
activities.description: Coordinate with the missionaries and family first, then join a visit in a way that is comfortable and supportive for everyone.

activities.title: Send a favorite general conference talk
activities.description: Send a friend a general conference talk you enjoy, with a brief note about what stood out to you.

activities.title: Share a recent spiritual journal entry
activities.description: Share a short excerpt or thought from a recent spiritual journal entry, choosing only what you are comfortable making personal.

activities.title: Let the missionaries know about a service opportunity
activities.description: If you know someone who could use help with a task such as yard work, ask permission before connecting them with the missionaries.

activities.title: Invite a friend to meet with missionaries
activities.description: Ask if a friend would like to meet with the missionaries. Explain what to expect and make it comfortable for them to decline.

activities.title: Invite friends to a mission story night
activities.description: Invite members and friends to share favorite stories from their missionary experiences. Keep the gathering relaxed and welcoming to everyone.

activities.title: Invite a friend to family home evening
activities.description: Invite a friend to join your family for a home evening activity, and let them know what the evening will be like.

activities.title: Invite a friend to a ward activity
activities.description: Tell a friend about an upcoming ward activity, share the details, and offer to meet them there.

activities.title: Invite a friend to Book of Mormon study
activities.description: Invite a friend to read or discuss a passage from the Book of Mormon together, at a time and pace that works for them.

activities.title: Invite a friend to sacrament meeting
activities.description: Invite a friend to attend sacrament meeting and offer to sit with them.

activities.title: Invite a friend to dinner with the missionaries
activities.description: Ask a friend if they would enjoy having dinner with you and the missionaries, and explain who will be there.

activities.title: Share how the Gospel has changed your life
activities.description: Tell a friend how an aspect of the Gospel of Jesus Christ, such as faith, repentance, or baptism, has influenced your life. Share only what feels comfortable and invite their perspective.

activities.title: Share a copy of the Book of Mormon
activities.description: Offer a friend a copy of the Book of Mormon and let them know you would be glad to talk about it if they are interested.

activities.title: Introduce yourself to a neighbor
activities.description: Knock at a neighbor's door at a considerate time, introduce yourself, and invite them to church. Keep the visit brief and respect their response.

activities.title: Share your testimony by text
activities.description: Send a short personal testimony to someone by text. Share only what feels comfortable and welcome their thoughts if they want to respond.

activities.title: Hold the door for someone
activities.description: Offer to hold a door for someone nearby. A small courtesy can help others feel welcome.

activities.title: Share a video about the Savior
activities.description: Make a brief video about a way you feel the Savior has blessed you, then share it with someone who may welcome it.

activities.title: Let someone know you’re praying for them
activities.description: If it feels welcome, tell someone you’re praying for them and ask if there is another way you can support them.

activities.title: Invite someone to catch up
activities.description: Invite someone to take a walk or drive together and catch up. Let them choose what works and make it easy to decline.

activities.title: Help with a family carpool
activities.description: Ask a family if help with carpool would be useful, then coordinate a time and ride that works for everyone.

activities.title: Invite a neighbor to family night
activities.description: Invite a neighbor to join your family for an activity or evening together, and let them know what to expect.

activities.title: Ask missionaries how you can help
activities.description: Ask the missionaries if there is a useful way you could support their work or serve someone they know.

activities.title: Offer a ride to a ward activity
activities.description: Offer someone a ride to an upcoming ward activity and make it comfortable for them to accept or decline.

activities.title: Show someone the Book of Mormon app
activities.description: If someone is interested, show them the Book of Mormon app and offer to help them find a passage or feature.

activities.title: Call a family member
activities.description: Call a family member to reconnect. Ask how they are doing and take time to listen.

activities.title: Share a snack and listen
activities.description: Invite someone to have a snack and talk. Let them choose what to share, and focus on listening.

activities.title: Make a spiritual playlist together
activities.description: Invite someone to build a playlist of uplifting or spiritual music together, choosing songs you both enjoy.

activities.title: Share a thought on a Church post
activities.description: Add a sincere, relevant comment about a Gospel truth on a Church post, keeping the conversation kind and respectful.

activities.title: Bring dinner to someone
activities.description: Ask whether a meal would be helpful, then arrange a dish and drop-off time that suits them.

activities.title: Check in with someone missionaries are teaching
activities.description: Send a friendly, no-pressure message to ask how they are doing. Respect their privacy and preferred pace.

activities.title: Offer your seat on public transit
activities.description: If someone nearby may need a seat, offer yours and let them decide whether to accept.

activities.title: Invite someone to temple night
activities.description: Ask if someone would like to join you for a ward temple night, and share the plans and practical details.

activities.title: Pray for someone you find difficult to love
activities.description: Pray for patience and compassion toward someone you find challenging. Consider one small, kind step you could take.

activities.title: Share a sacrament meeting reflection
activities.description: Text someone in your ward about something from the sacrament that felt meaningful to you this week.

activities.title: Encourage friends to contact a missionary
activities.description: Suggest that friends reach out to someone they know who is serving a mission, such as with a message of support.

activities.title: Send a photo to reconnect
activities.description: Send a friend a photo of the two of you with a warm note. Ask how they have been since you last caught up.

activities.title: Pray for missionary experiences together
activities.description: Ask a friend if they would like to pray with you for opportunities to serve and connect with others.

activities.title: Share how faith helped during finals
activities.description: If it comes up naturally, tell a classmate how faith helped you through finals and ask about their experience.

activities.title: Invite a friend to a devotional
activities.description: Invite a friend to an upcoming devotional and offer to attend together.

activities.title: Share why you believe
activities.description: Write or send a brief personal message about why you believe. Keep it in your own words and share without pressure.

activities.title: Recommend a Gospel podcast
activities.description: Suggest a Gospel-centered podcast episode to your sibling and mention what you found interesting or helpful.

activities.title: Invite a friend to a ward baptism
activities.description: Invite a friend to attend a ward baptism. Explain what the event will be like and offer to sit with them.

activities.title: Share a personal experience with a friend
activities.description: Tell a friend about an experience that felt meaningful or miraculous to you, and why it stayed with you.

activities.title: Share a recent mission story
activities.description: Forward a mission story to your family group with a short note about what stood out to you.

activities.title: Invite someone for a walk
activities.description: Ask someone if they would like to take a walk with you and have a conversation.

activities.title: Greet someone warmly
activities.description: Offer someone a sincere hello and a smile. If they seem open to talking, take a moment to connect.

activities.title: Invite a coworker to a ward activity
activities.description: Tell a coworker about an upcoming ward activity, share the details, and offer to meet them there.

activities.title: Invite friends to share a testimony
activities.description: Invite friends to share a brief testimony in the group chat if they would like. Avoid putting anyone on the spot.

activities.title: Send a thoughtful care gift
activities.description: Choose a small, considerate gift for someone and include a brief note letting them know you thought of them.

activities.title: Invite a friend to a youth activity
activities.description: Let a friend know about a youth activity and invite them to come, sharing the details that would help them decide.

activities.title: Share a Come, Follow Me verse
activities.description: Send your sibling a verse from Come, Follow Me and add a sentence about why you chose it.

activities.title: Share a conference quote
activities.description: Send or post a conference quote that matters to you, and briefly explain how it has influenced you.

activities.title: Set a spiritual goal with a colleague
activities.description: Ask a colleague if they would like to choose a personal spiritual goal for the week and check in with each other.

activities.title: Wish someone a happy birthday
activities.description: Send a birthday message that feels personal, such as a kind memory or something you appreciate about them.

activities.title: Invite family to pray by video call
activities.description: Ask a family member who lives far away if they would like to pray together by video call at a time that suits them.

activities.title: Bring dinner to a neighbor
activities.description: Ask a neighbor if a meal would be helpful, and arrange a dish and delivery time that works for them.

activities.title: Share a favorite hymn
activities.description: Send a neighbor a hymn you enjoy and tell them what you appreciate about it.

activities.title: Recommend Gospel Library
activities.description: If it fits the conversation, tell someone about the Gospel Library app and a resource or feature you find useful.

activities.title: Share an uplifting Gospel quote
activities.description: Send someone a Gospel quote that lifted you recently, with a brief note about why it resonated.

activities.title: Welcome a new neighbor with help
activities.description: Introduce yourself to a neighbor who recently moved in and offer a specific kind of help, without pressure.

activities.title: Encourage someone nearby
activities.description: Offer someone a sincere, specific word of encouragement. Keep it simple and genuine.

activities.title: Share how the Book of Mormon has helped you
activities.description: Tell a friend what you value about the Book of Mormon and how it has strengthened you. Make space for their perspective.

activities.title: Say hello to a neighbor
activities.description: Greet a neighbor when you see them. A friendly introduction can be the start of getting to know each other.

activities.title: Plan with missionaries over dinner
activities.description: Invite the missionaries for dinner and, if useful, talk together about thoughtful ways to share the Gospel.

activities.title: Invite an old friend to lunch
activities.description: Call a friend you have not seen in a while and ask if they would like to get lunch and catch up.

activities.title: Invite a friend to ward basketball
activities.description: Invite a friend to join a basketball activity with your ward and explain what to expect.

activities.title: Check in with someone you haven’t seen lately
activities.description: Reach out warmly to someone you have not seen at church recently. Ask how they are doing and let them guide the conversation.

activities.title: Share what you love about Jesus Christ
activities.description: Choose someone you know who may welcome the message and share one thing you love about Jesus Christ. Avoid sending unexpected mass messages.

activities.title: Host a mission story night
activities.description: Invite friends, members and nonmembers, to share meaningful mission stories in a relaxed, welcoming setting.

activities.title: Share a Gospel thought in a group chat
activities.description: Share a brief Gospel thought in a group chat when it fits the conversation, without expecting everyone to respond.

activities.title: Offer lunch to a stressed coworker
activities.description: Ask a coworker having a stressful time whether you can bring or pick up lunch for them.

activities.title: Invite family to volunteer with you
activities.description: Ask a family member if they would like to join you for a service activity, and find a time that works for both of you.

activities.title: Share what you believe
activities.description: In a conversation where faith comes up, share one belief that matters to you and listen with curiosity to the other person.

activities.title: Organize a neighborhood service project
activities.description: Choose a manageable JustServe project, confirm the details, and invite neighbors to participate if they are interested.

activities.title: Listen to a conference talk together
activities.description: Invite a friend to listen to a conference talk you enjoy, then share what stood out to each of you.

activities.title: Recommend a faith-centered podcast
activities.description: Recommend a Gospel-centered podcast episode to a family member and explain what you enjoyed about it.

activities.title: Leave a note of encouragement
activities.description: Write a short, kind note for someone and leave it somewhere appropriate for them to find.

activities.title: Practice Gospel conversations as a family
activities.description: Try a lighthearted role-play at home to practice sharing beliefs and listening respectfully. Keep participation comfortable for everyone.

activities.title: Pray for missionary experiences
activities.description: Pray for chances to serve and connect with others, and for awareness to recognize those opportunities.

activities.title: Help someone tidy or organize
activities.description: Ask someone if there is a small cleaning or organizing task they would appreciate help with.

activities.title: Invite someone to a devotional or ward prayer
activities.description: Share the time and details of an upcoming devotional or ward prayer and invite someone to join you.

activities.title: Share a spiritual thought with friends
activities.description: Send a brief spiritual thought to your friend group when it feels natural, and leave room for others to engage or move on.

activities.title: Pack care boxes
activities.description: Put together a care box with useful items for people in need. Check what is needed and where donations can be delivered.

activities.title: Thank someone for their influence
activities.description: Call someone who has made a difference in your life and tell them specifically what you appreciate.

activities.title: Pray for someone nearby
activities.description: Quietly pray for someone you encounter, wishing them comfort, strength, or whatever support they may need.

activities.title: Invite someone to fast with you
activities.description: Ask someone if they would like to join you in fasting on Sunday, while respecting their personal circumstances and choice.

activities.title: Share a song you’ve been listening to
activities.description: Send a family member a hymn or song you have enjoyed recently and mention what you like about it.

activities.title: Recommend a Church book
activities.description: Tell a friend about a Church book or series you have enjoyed and what made it meaningful to you.

activities.title: Share the Book of Mormon app
activities.description: Show someone the Book of Mormon app and a feature they might find useful, if they are interested.

activities.title: Send support to someone having a hard time
activities.description: Send a caring message to someone going through a difficult time. Let them know you are available without expecting a reply.

activities.title: Share your testimony with a friend
activities.description: Send a friend a brief personal testimony. Keep it sincere and give them room to respond in their own way.

activities.title: Share a helpful verse with a friend
activities.description: Send a friend a scripture that has helped you, with a short note about why you thought of them.

activities.title: Invite a neighbor to a family activity
activities.description: Invite a neighbor to join a family activity and let them know what it involves.

activities.title: Share a journal entry about Christ
activities.description: Choose an older journal entry that reflects your faith in Christ and share an excerpt you feel comfortable making personal.

activities.title: Send a church photo to reconnect
activities.description: Share a recent church photo with someone you have lost touch with and add a friendly note to reopen conversation.

activities.title: Study a talk with your roommate
activities.description: Ask your roommate if they would like to read or listen to a talk together this weekend and discuss what stood out.

activities.title: Share your faith story at a sports activity
activities.description: If faith comes up naturally while playing sports, tell a friend about an experience that shaped your beliefs and listen to their perspective.

activities.title: Share a Gospel image you enjoy
activities.description: Post or send a Gospel-related image that made you smile, with a short note about what you like about it.

activities.title: Record a short testimony
activities.description: Record a brief testimony and share it with someone you know who may appreciate it. Choose the recipient thoughtfully and avoid putting them on the spot.

activities.title: Read the Book of Mormon with a friend
activities.description: Offer to read a passage from the Book of Mormon with a friend, at a pace and time that works for them.

activities.title: Share how the Book of Mormon has strengthened your faith
activities.description: Post a personal reflection about how reading the Book of Mormon has influenced your faith.

activities.title: Ask a friend to share a favorite quote
activities.description: Invite a friend to share a Gospel quote they like, and offer one of your own if they are interested.

activities.title: Do a quiet act of service
activities.description: Choose a helpful task for someone important to you and do it without seeking recognition. Make sure the help is welcome.

activities.title: Invite a friend to church
activities.description: Invite a friend to church this Sunday and, if they accept, coordinate a ride and any other practical details.

activities.title: Share a moment of peace
activities.description: If the moment feels right, tell someone nearby about a time today when you felt peace from the Spirit.

activities.title: Plan an activity with missionaries and a friend
activities.description: Text a friend to ask if they would enjoy a shared activity with you and the missionaries. Explain the plan and leave the choice to them.

activities.title: Study Come, Follow Me with a roommate
activities.description: Ask your roommate if they would like to read or discuss a Come, Follow Me passage together.

activities.title: Bring a treat to someone you appreciate
activities.description: Drop off a small treat for someone you appreciate, with a brief note to let them know why you thought of them.

activities.title: Spend time with an older adult
activities.description: Ask an older adult if they would enjoy a conversation. Give them time to share what is on their mind.

activities.title: Invite a family to church and a meal
activities.description: Invite a family to church on Sunday and, if they are interested, plan to share lunch or dinner afterward.

activities.title: Leave someone a kind note
activities.description: Write a short, affectionate note for someone and leave it somewhere they will find it.

activities.title: Share a Church video or quote
activities.description: Send a neighbor a Church video or quote you found meaningful, with a brief explanation of why you thought of them.

activities.title: Share testimonies online together
activities.description: Invite friends to share a testimony on social media on a day they choose. Keep participation optional and comfortable.

activities.title: Watch a scripture video together
activities.description: Ask a family member if they would like to watch a Bible or Book of Mormon video with you.

activities.title: Invite a sports friend to a YSA activity
activities.description: Let a friend you know through sports know they are welcome at an upcoming YSA activity and share the details.

activities.title: Tutor a friend and share what motivates you
activities.description: Offer a friend help with a subject they are studying. If it comes up naturally, share how your faith influences the way you support others.

activities.title: Share your faith journey
activities.description: Tell a friend about an experience that shaped your faith. Share at a pace that feels comfortable and invite their perspective.

activities.title: Remind a friend of Christ’s love
activities.description: Send a friend a thoughtful message about Christ’s love, keeping the wording personal and encouraging.

activities.title: Walk to sacrament meeting together
activities.description: Invite a friend to walk with you to sacrament meeting and offer to meet at a convenient place.

activities.title: Invite someone to watch a Church video
activities.description: If it feels appropriate, invite someone you spoke with today to watch a Church video together or send it for them to view.

activities.title: Share a favorite scripture
activities.description: Post a scripture you enjoy to your social story with a short note about why it matters to you.

activities.title: Share the Church Instagram page
activities.description: If someone is interested in Church content, point them to the Church Instagram page and let them decide whether to follow it.

activities.title: Leave someone a favorite scripture
activities.description: Write a scripture you appreciate on a note and leave it somewhere appropriate for someone who may enjoy finding it.

activities.title: Offer a parent a break
activities.description: Ask a parent you know if a little childcare help would give them a chance to rest, and arrange details only if welcome.

activities.title: Share a Gospel insight from your journal
activities.description: Choose a Gospel insight from your journal or mission experience and share an excerpt that feels appropriate and personal.

activities.title: Invite someone to sit with you at lunch
activities.description: Ask someone new if they would like to join you for lunch. Welcome them without making them feel obliged.

activities.title: Plan dinner with another family
activities.description: Ask a nearby family if they would enjoy sharing a meal, then find a time and place that works for everyone.

activities.title: Plan a conference rewatch with a friend
activities.description: Text a friend to ask if they would like to choose a time to rewatch a general conference talk or session together.
